newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Iran denies role in attack on Saddam's son.
newsitem.headline: Iran denies role in attack on Saddam's son.

text.p: An Iranian official denied in remarks published on Thursday that Tehran played any part in the assassination attempt against Iraqi president Saddam Hussein's son, Uday, as he has appeared to suggest.
"The least that can be said about this (accusation) is that it is baseless," Kuwait's al-Rai al-Aam daily quoted Mahmoud Mohammadi, an Iranian foreign ministry spokesman, as saying.
"We have no interest in assassinating Uday or any other official in Baghdad," said Mohammadi.
Uday, who was shot last Thursdayw while driving through a posh Baghdad neighbourhood, appeared to blame neighbouring Iran for the attack in a Baghdad television interview on Tuesday.
"The treacherous people are known along with the place they come from....they tested us for eight years," he said in an apparent reference to the 1980-88 Iran-Iraq war.
Iraqi opposition groups have claimed resposibility for the attack.
